test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 2 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

Madhu is __only a__ daughter of her parents.
solution:
The correct option is **"the only".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** Here, **only is used as an adje
